text: What time does Paul Gallen vs Nelson Asofa-Solomona start and who’s on the full fight card? What time does Paul Gallen vs Nelson Asofa-Solomona start and who’s on the full fight card? The stage is set for a blockbuster heavyweight showdown between Paul Gallen and Nelson Asofa-Solomona, with the two former NRL stars set to go head-to-head in Sydney tonight. Gallen will come out of retirement to take on the unbeaten Asofa-Solomona, with tensions between the pair reaching boiling point throughout the build-up to their highly anticipated clash. The former NSW Origin captain enters the fight with a professional record of 16 wins, two losses and one draw, whilst Asofa-Solomona remains unbeaten through his first three professional fights, all coming by knockout.Gallen v Asofa-Solomona | Friday November 6 from 7pm AEDT | Australian sporting icon and crossover boxing king Paul Gallen returns to the ring to face his biggest opponent yet, Nelson ‘Big Nasty’ Asofa-Solomona. | From accusations surrounding performance-enhancing drugs to Gallen threatening to kick his rival’s head “off his shoulders” after comments about his wife, there has been no shortage of drama between the two heavyweights.With both fighters trading insults throughout fight week, all eyes now turn to what happens when they finally step inside the ring. From the start time and full fight card to how you can watch the action, here’s everything you need to know ahead of Friday night’s blockbuster showdown.
